title: Best Friends Forever
intro: [excited] Welcome, welcome, WELCOME to the Best Friends Forever episode! Tonight it's sidekicks, buddies, and partners in crime. [mischievously] Look to your left... that person is your best friend for exactly one more category.

art.prompt: Two mismatched swings hanging side by side from a huge old oak tree on a grassy hill at sunset, friendship bracelets tied to the ropes, a treehouse above, fireflies, and two glowing lanterns Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

categories.title: You've Got a Friend in Me
categories.intro: Our film category is all about the most famous toy friendship ever. [laughs] Reach for the sky, partner!

art.prompt: A child's bedroom with cloud-patterned wallpaper, a toy cowboy hat and a toy space helmet side by side on the bed, a toy rocket and building blocks on the floor, warm morning light Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: This pull-string cowboy doll is Andy's favorite toy... at least until a space ranger shows up.
clues.reveal: [cheerful] The correct answer is Woody! There's a snake in his boot, and a friend in his heart. Awww.

clues.clue: This space ranger's famous catchphrase is To infinity and beyond!
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Buzz Lightyear! [laughs] He's not flying, he's falling WITH STYLE.

clues.clue: Woody and Buzz both have this kid's name written on the bottom of their boots.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Andy! [chuckles] Writing your name on your friends is a big commitment. Please don't try that at school.

clues.clue: This singer-songwriter wrote and performed the Toy Story theme, You've Got a Friend in Me.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Randy Newman! [excited] He finally won his first Oscar for a Pixar song, If I Didn't Have You, from Monsters, Inc.

clues.clue: In Toy Story 4, Bo Peep's three-headed sheep are named Billy, Goat, and this.
clues.reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is Gruff! Billy, Goat, and Gruff, a fairy tale joke hiding in plain sight. Give yourself a gold star, nerd.

categories.title: Sidekick Squad
categories.intro: [dramatic pause] Every hero needs a sidekick. Tonight the sidekicks finally get the spotlight. [whispers] Don't tell the princesses.

art.prompt: A lineup of tiny sidekick accessories on a stage: a seashell, a little red-and-gold gong, a glowing firefly lantern, a tiny paintbrush, a bundle of grubs on a leaf, under a spotlight Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: Ariel's yellow and blue best fish friend.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Flounder! [laughs] Ariel calls him a guppy, which is honestly a little rude.

clues.clue: Pumbaa's best friend is this wisecracking meerkat.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Timon! Hakuna Matata, it means no worries for the rest of your days. [chuckles] Unless you're on this board.

clues.clue: Mulan's tiny dragon buddy, voiced by Eddie Murphy.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Mushu! [sarcastic] He's not a lizard, he's a DRAGON. Please, get it right.

clues.clue: Tiana's lovesick firefly friend, who's head over heels for the Evening Star.
clues.reveal: [sighs] The correct answer is Ray! Spoiler, his Evangeline is the Evening Star, and he ends up right next to her. Pass the tissues.

clues.clue: In Pocahontas, this is the name of the tiny hummingbird pal.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Flit! [impressed] Meeko the raccoon steals the snacks, but Flit steals the show. True nerd points for you.

categories.title: Friendship Under the Microscope
categories.intro: Our picture category starts SUPER zoomed in and slowly pulls back. [mischievously] Buzz in early for glory, or wait and look like a genius.

art.prompt: A giant brass magnifying glass over a scrapbook of friendship mementos: bottle caps, concert ticket stubs, pressed flowers, a seashell, and a friendship bracelet Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: Zoom out on this scene. Which movie about an old man and a Wilderness Explorer does it come from?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Up! [excited] The grape soda bottle cap, the Ellie Badge, is the best friendship award ever made.

media.prompt: Extreme close-up of a weathered orange grape-soda bottle cap pinned like a badge onto a khaki scout sash covered in merit patches, a bunch of colorful helium balloons blurred in the background, golden late-afternoon light. Original illustration, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: Zoom out on this beach scene. Which film's friendship teaches us that ohana means family?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Lilo and Stitch! [chuckles] Peanut butter sandwiches for the fish, of course. Ohana means nobody gets left behind.

media.prompt: A Hawaiian beach at sunset, a small ukulele leaning on a surfboard in the sand, a peanut butter sandwich on a paper plate next to a tide pool, a little red wagon, warm pink and orange sky. Original illustration, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: Zoom out on this city scene. Which movie pairs a bunny cop with a fox con artist?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Zootopia! [laughs] It's called a hustle, sweetheart. That carrot pen recorder deserves its own award.

media.prompt: A carrot-shaped pen recorder lying on a police desk beside a parking ticket pad and a tiny traffic cone, rainy window behind showing a glowing city with districts of rainforest, ice, and desert skyscrapers. Original illustration, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: Zoom out on this seaside scene. In which film do two sea monster friends dream of owning this?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Luca! [excited] Silenzio, Bruno! A homemade scooter is the ultimate symbol of best-friend teamwork.

media.prompt: A rickety homemade scooter built from scrap wood, rope, and old wheels perched on a sunny Italian seaside cliff, a colorful fishing village and turquoise sea below, a poster-free stone wall, summer haze. Original illustration, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: Zoom out on this farm scene. Which 1981 Disney film is about two pals who are told they're supposed to be enemies?
clues.reveal: [sighs] The correct answer is The Fox and the Hound! Tod and Copper, friends forever, no matter what. Somebody hand me a hanky.

media.prompt: A rustic wooden farm fence at the edge of an autumn forest, a worn leather hound's collar hanging on a post, a fox den tucked under tree roots nearby, morning mist and falling orange leaves. Original illustration, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

categories.title: Friends Like Me
categories.intro: Now let's head to the parks, where the BFFs have their own rides, shows, and statues. [laughs] Yes, statues. We'll get there.

art.prompt: A theme park hub at dusk with a fairy-tale castle, a bronze statue base wrapped in flowers, a small striped circus-tent kid coaster, and a whimsical cartoon town with crooked buildings Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: Mickey's tall, clumsy best pal has his own kid coaster in Magic Kingdom's Storybook Circus, called this character's Barnstormer.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Goofy! [laughs] Gawrsh! He's billed as the Great Goofini, a daredevil stunt pilot. Brave? Yes. Skilled? Debatable.

clues.clue: Mike and Sulley host this comedy show in Magic Kingdom's Tomorrowland, where your laughs power the city.
choices: Mike and Sulley to the Rescue!
Monsters, Inc. Ride and Go Seek
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Monsters, Inc. Laugh Floor! [chuckles] You can text in your own jokes. Please, send better ones than mine.

clues.clue: These two chipmunk best friends have their names on a kid coaster in Disneyland's Mickey's Toontown.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Chip 'n' Dale! [excited] Their GADGETcoaster was built by inventor mouse Gadget Hackwrench out of, yes, giant acorns.

clues.clue: Mickey and his sweetheart take a wild train ride through cartoon world in this attraction inside Hollywood Studios' Chinese Theater.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Mickey and Minnie's Runaway Railway! [laughs] Goofy is the engineer, which explains a LOT about the driving.

clues.clue: The famous statue of Walt Disney holding hands with his best pal Mickey Mouse in front of the castle has this one-word name.
clues.reveal: [whispers] The correct answer is Partners. Sculpted by legendary Imagineer Blaine Gibson. [excited] Okay, you can stop pretending you knew that.

categories.title: Better Together
categories.intro: Our wildcard category is all about the dynamic duos. [chuckles] Name the missing half, and no phoning a friend.

art.prompt: Perfect pairs arranged like a puzzle: peanut butter and jelly, salt and pepper shakers, two puzzle pieces clicking together, two acorns, and two old theater balcony seats Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: Mickey Mouse's loyal pup.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Pluto! [laughs] Goofy is a dog who talks and wears pants. Pluto is a dog who does not. Don't ask.

clues.clue: Winnie the Pooh's very small, very nervous best friend.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Piglet! Oh d-d-dear. [cheerful] Pooh says it's never too small to be a big friend.

clues.clue: Kristoff's best friend is this reindeer, who's better than people.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Sven! [chuckles] Kristoff does all of Sven's talking for him, which is the most best friend thing ever.

clues.clue: These two grumpy old pals heckle everyone from their balcony seats on The Muppet Show.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Statler and Waldorf! [sarcastic] Oh, they would LOVE my jokes tonight. Doh ho ho ho!

clues.clue: In The Rescuers, mice Bernard and Miss Bianca are agents of this international mouse organization.
clues.reveal: [impressed] The correct answer is the Rescue Aid Society! Headquartered in the basement of the United Nations. Best friends AND international spies.
